Overview of UP PET Security and Recent Incidents

Recent reports from Navbharat Times highlight heightened security measures and an unusual malpractice attempt during the Uttar Pradesh Preliminary Eligibility Test (UP PET). While officials deployed advanced surveillance technologies to maintain exam integrity, specific incidents of cheating have drawn attention to the ongoing challenges in conducting large-scale state examinations.

According to the published report, authorities implemented stringent entry protocols at examination centers. However, an unusual case emerged at a center in Jhansi, where a candidate was reportedly found wearing a sanitary pad in an attempt to conceal a prohibited electronic device, which was suspected due to a rustling sound.

Exam Security Measures

To prevent malpractice and ensure transparency, the conducting authorities utilized a multi-layered security framework across test venues:

  • AI and Live CCTV Monitoring: Special control rooms tracked live feeds from examination halls to detect suspicious activities.
  • Biometric and Retina Scans: Entry procedures included mandatory biometric attendance and retinal scans to prevent proxy test-takers and dummy candidates.
  • Law Enforcement Deployment: Personnel from the Uttar Pradesh Special Task Force (UP STF) and local intelligence units were deployed on-site to oversee security.
